title: One fixed fee per order
hook: The same goods can produce different totals when a fee repeats.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Separate per-order charges from per-item costs.

misconception: Equal merchandise subtotals guarantee equal checkout totals.
objective: Separate per-order charges from per-item costs.

claims.text: The same goods total €24. Each order adds a fictional €4 delivery fee. Scaled model; same goods; €4/order; no discounts.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Orders=2, A=€32 and B=€28. Geometry follows the declared dimension relationships. Other pictures use a fixed full scale across the slider range; continuous fills and arcs show relative amounts rather than literal object counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["+",24,["*",4,"x"]]; B=28; x denotes Orders. At x=2, A=32, B=28. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. Diagram scale: resourceGraphicScale in resource-model.ts takes the maximum modeled magnitude across both formulas and the declared slider range. For non-geometry figures, full-scale values are displayed; the scale stays fixed when the slider changes. Energy axis endpoints use resourceAxisEnd, including B=5×A hours in lh-watts-hours-trade; cylinder rx and ry both scale with radius in resourceCylinderDimensions. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: A fixed fee repeats with each order. Combining changes the number of fees in this toy policy, not the merchandise subtotal. Count how many times each line is charged.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["+",24,["*",4,"x"]]; B=28; x denotes Orders. claims.text: The same goods total €24, and each order adds a fictional €4 delivery fee. Placing three orders instead of one adds how much to the receipts? Correct: €8. The fee repeats per order: three orders pay three fees, one order pays one, a difference of two fees (€8).

recall.question: The same goods total €24, and each order adds a fictional €4 delivery fee. Placing three orders instead of one adds how much to the receipts?
recall.why: The fee repeats per order: three orders pay three fees, one order pays one, a difference of two fees (€8).
